column2: Right as the gates are shut I start to consider whether dispatching a foraging party to gather additional food in [seclusion_food_province.GetName] would be a wise idea. One of my courtiers would go, while I would remain in seclusion with the rest of my court. The risk of us all catching a disease as a result should be minimal.
[gather_food_option_1.GetBestName] is the [gather_food_option_1.GetManWoman] for the job!
I will send [gather_food_option_2.GetBestName]!
I think [gather_food_option_3.GetBestName] would be best!
It is not worth it...

As [From.GetBestName] no longer resides in my court [From.GetSheHe] has not returned with the party I sent to gather additional food. Even so, the supplies that have been brought back are fairly substantial.
This will do just fine!
[From.GetBestName] has returned with the party that was sent to acquire more food for us. They succeded, and the peasants in [seclusion_food_province.GetName] seem content enough with what happened.
Good work, [From.GetFirstName]!
Thank you for the food. You can leave now!

[From.GetBestName] has returned with the party that was sent to acquire more food for us. They managed to acquire quite a bit of food, but the peasants in [seclusion_food_province.GetName] were apparently most upset with them.
I can't say it's completely unexpected...
Thank you for the food. You can leave now!

The party [From.GetBestName] left with has returned without [From.GetHerHim], bringing a smaller amount of food than expected. It seems some of the peasants of [seclusion_food_province.GetName] saw fit to attack the party over the supposed theft of their food, and [From.GetBestName] was killed in the fighting.
Those peasants should show proper respect!

[From.GetBestName]'s party has returned without [From.GetHerHim], with a number of those that have returned looking less than healthy. It seems [From.GetBestName] died from some kind of disease, and it might perhaps spread in my court now.
This might have been a mistake, even if we now have some more food...

It seems [From.GetBestName] has died. The others that left with [From.GetHerHim] have returned with the food that they had managed to gather, but it seems to be a smaller amount than they probably would have been able to gather if [From.GetBestName] still had been alive.
I see...
Life in seclusion is unlikely to be the same as life outside seclusion. I should perhaps try to focus on something in particular to make the most of this time.
We shall pray for things to get better!
We should enjoy ourselves!
I think I will try to keep busy!
We should aim to make the food last for as long as possible!
We should grow our own food!
This is an opportunity to discover secrets!
Finally I can afford to relax!
Let's try to live as we normally would...

Now that I am in charge I need to decide how to spend my time in seclusion. I could perhaps focus on something in particular, if just trying to live as I normally would does not seem like the best idea.
We shall pray for things to get better!
We should enjoy ourselves!
I think I will try to keep busy!
We should aim to make the food last for as long as possible!
We should grow our own food!
This is an opportunity to discover secrets!
Finally I can afford to relax!
Let's try to live as we normally would...
I have realized that my former approach to this time in seclusion is not right for me, and should consider some other approach instead.
We shall pray for things to get better!
We should enjoy ourselves!
I think I will try to keep busy!
We should aim to make the food last for as long as possible!
We should grow our own food!
This is an opportunity to discover secrets!
Finally I can afford to relax!
Let's try to live as we normally would...
I have been in seclusion for quite some time now, and perhaps I could focus on something better with this time than what I am currently trying to focus on.
Perhaps it is time...
I see little reason to change my approach!
I need to decide on my new approach to the time I am spending in seclusion. Attempting to live as I normally would is certainly an option, but perhaps it is not the most appealing one.
We should enjoy ourselves!
We shall pray for things to get better!
I think I will try to keep busy!
We should aim to make the food last for as long as possible!
We should grow our own food!
This is an opportunity to discover secrets!
Finally I can afford to relax!
Let's try to live as we normally would...

It would perhaps be a good idea for me to appoint someone to guard the food reserves while we remain in seclusion, seeing as there might be those that would seek to eat more than their alloted share. I should pick someone I trust for this important task.
[food_guard_option_1.GetBestName] seems like the [food_guard_option_1.GetManWoman] for the job!
I will put [food_guard_option_2.GetBestName] in charge of the food!
[food_guard_option_3.GetBestName] is clearly a good choice!
Actually, I don't really see the point...

Several people that I am close to have been asking me whether I would be willing to help them get some more food. This is not in accordance with the instructions I have been given by [From.GetBestName], but I guess I am in a position to decide...
I will let them eat...
I will have to refuse...

[bribing_courtier.GetBestName] just approached me with the suggestion that [bribing_courtier.GetSheHe] could pay me quite handsomely in exchange for me giving [bribing_courtier.GetHerHim] and certain others access to the food supplies. [From.GetBestName] would probably not approve, but perhaps [From.GetSheHe] does not need to know.
We have a deal!
I will not be bribed!

I have been quite hungry of late, and that is somewhat interfering with my ability to carry out the important task of guarding [From.GetBestName]'s food. Perhaps I should get myself something to eat so that I can focus?
I'm sure [From.GetBestName] would understand!
I am better than this...

One of my agents just came to inform me that [Root.GetSheHe] has proof that [From.GetBestName] has not been guarding the food as well as could be desired. It seems [From.GetSheHe] might be letting people eat just due to being friends or family or in exchange for money, and [From.GetSheHe] might even be eating on the job.
I can let it slide...
I need to find someone else to guard the food...
Guards! Throw [From.GetHerHim] in a cell!

I have been very hungry lately, and neither [From.GetBestName] nor [food_guard.GetBestName] has been willing to give me more to eat. At this time, the food reserves seem unguarded, however, which might be an opportunity for me...
I will grab some without anyone noticing...
It is too risky...

I just caught [From.GetBestName] attempting to steal some food from the food reserves. [From.GetSheHeCap] is in no position to deny it, and I could easily summon the guards and have [From.GetHerHim] dragged before [FromFrom.GetBestName].
Leave before I change my mind!
Guards! Seize [From.GetHerHim]!
[From.GetBestName] just had the guards drag [FromFrom.GetBestName] in front of me. Apparently, [FromFrom.GetSheHe] was caught attempting to steal from the food reserves.
I can let it slide...
Guards! Take [FromFrom.GetHerHim] to the dungeons!

As I returned to watch over the food reserves after speaking to one of the servants about an important matter I noticed that the doors were standing slightly ajar. Inside, I could see signs that someone had been inside, clearly having stolen some of the food.
Who could have done this?

[From.GetBestName] just informed me that someone apparently has gotten inside one of the storerooms where the food reserves are being stored. [From.GetSheHeCap] does not know who it was, and [From.GetSheHe] regrets to inform me that some of the food has gone missing.
Who could have done this?

[food_guard.GetBestName] guards [From.GetBestName]'s food reserves very carefully, and I and many others are suffering from the lack of food. If [food_guard.GetSheHe] could be removed from the picture, we could all eat our fill... so perhaps I should make sure that happens...
[food_guard.GetSheHeCap] must die!
It would be risky and wrong...

Without warning, a throwing knife comes flying in my direction as I am on my way back to my chambers after spending the day watching over [FromFrom.GetBestName]'s food stores. Luckily, the knife misses, but I am unable to catch any sign of the attacker when I search for them.
Who was that?

I have just been informed that [From.GetBestName] was attacked by an unknown assailant. [From.GetSheHeCap] is unharmed, but it seems someone might not be very happy with the way [From.GetSheHe] is guarding my food stores.
Dangerous times...

Without warning, a throwing knife comes flying in my direction as I am on my way back to my chambers after spending the day watching over [FromFrom.GetBestName]'s food stores. The knife misses, and as I turn towards where it came from I can see [From.GetBestName] standing there.
I saw you!

I have just beeen informed that [From.GetBestName] was attacked by [FromFrom.GetBestName]. Apparently, [FromFrom.GetBestName] has taken issue with how well [From.GetBestName] has been guarding the food stores.
Don't do it again!
Guards! Throw [FromFrom.GetHerHim] in a cell!

Without warning, a throwing knife comes flying in my direction as I am on my way back to my chambers after spending the day watching over [FromFrom.GetBestName]'s food stores. I try to dodge out of the way, but the attacker's aim is true, and the wound is fatal.
Who was th-?

One of my guards just informed me that [From.GetBestName]'s body has been found with a throwing knife embedded in [From.GetHerHis] chest. Despite searching the scene for any clues as to who might have attacked [From.GetHerHim], the guards have not been able to identify any obvious suspects.
Who did this?

Without warning, a throwing knife comes flying in my direction as I am on my way back to my chambers after spending the day watching over [FromFrom.GetBestName]'s food stores. I try to dodge out of the way, but the attacker's aim is true, and the wound is fatal. Looking over where it came from, I can see [From.GetBestName].
You? No!

I have just been informed that [From.GetBestName] has been murdered in cold blood. Several people saw [FromFrom.GetBestName] throw the knife that did the deed, and [FromFrom.GetSheHe] has not denied this, stating that [From.GetBestName] had it coming after not letting [FromFrom.GetHerHim] eat.
I suppose I can't fault [FromFrom.GetHerHim]...
Guards! Throw [FromFrom.GetHerHim] in a cell!
It seems my faith and my prayers has inspired [converting_courtier.GetBestName] to convert from the [converting_courtier.Religion.GetName] faith to the [Root.Religion.GetName] faith.
That is good news!

Though [praying_courtier.GetBestName] does not follow the [Root.Religion.GetName] faith it seems my prayers have inspired [praying_courtier.GetHerHim] to start praying for us all to be safe in these dangerous times.
I will allow it...
How can I be sure what [praying_courtier.GetSheHe] truly is praying for?
[praying_courtier.GetSheHeCap] needs to stop at once!

[annoyed_courtier.GetBestName] is most displeased with my prayers, telling me that they are a waste of time as the [Root.Religion.GetName] faith's teachings will not save us in these times. Clearly, [annoyed_courtier.GetHerHis] [annoyed_courtier.Religion.GetName] beliefs are the reason for this.
You can't please everyone...

[happy_courtier.GetBestName] has let me know that [happy_courtier.GetBestName] fully approves of my decision to pray for us to remain safe in these dangerous times. [happy_courtier.GetSheHeCap] has also been praying, [happy_courtier.GetSheHe] tells me, and our shared [Root.Religion.GetName] faith will be our salvation.
I knew I made a good choice!
[Root.Capital.GetName] is not suffering from disease, and it might be safe to reopen the gates soon. My prayers might be the reason why we are safe.
Faith alone will save us in these dark times!
I have been praying night and day, and yet [Root.Capital.GetName] is suffering from disease. Why is it not working? Why? Am I not a good [Root.Religion.GetName]?
Is my faith... wrong?
I must pray harder!
I am sick, even though I have been praying to remain healthy. This should not be happening according to the teachings of the [Root.Religion.GetName] faith!
Prayer is pointless!
My prayers have not been effective, and my faith has been shaken. Maybe, just maybe, the [conversion_target.Religion.GetName] faith is the key to our salvation...
Conversion is the only choice!
I will convert in secret...
I don't think so!

[conversion_target.GetBestName] has asked me for an audience. It seems [conversion_target.GetSheHe] thinks my attempt to pray for salvation is laudable but ultimately pointless, seeing as I am not praying to [conversion_target.Religion.GetHighGodName] in accordance with the teachings of the [conversion_target.Religion.GetName] faith. [conversion_target.GetSheHeCap] suggests that I should convert.
You have convinced me, [conversion_target.GetFirstName]!
I won't convert... at least not publicly...
Never suggest that again!
Guards! Imprison [conversion_target.GetHerHim]!

Lately I have been spending quite a bit of time in the company of [seclusion_friend.GetBestName] as we both are in seclusion together. [seclusion_friend.GetSheHeCap] is a very interesting [seclusion_friend.GetManWoman], and I have enjoyed [seclusion_friend.GetHerHis] company quite a bit. The feeling seems to be mutual.
This seclusion thing might not be so bad...

I have noticed that [friendly_courtier_1.GetBestName] and [friendly_courtier_2.GetBestName] seems to be getting along quite well. Perhaps the festive atmosphere I arranged helped them find common ground.
This can only meen good things!
Good for them!
A strange choice...
I see...
A strange choice...
I see...
They might be conspiring against me...

Being stuck in seclusion has been unpleasant despite me trying to make things enjoyable for everyone. One of the main causes for this is [seclusion_rival.GetBestName]. That [seclusion_rival.GetManWoman] has been doing everything possible to get on my nerves, and [seclusion_rival.GetSheHe] seems to think that I have been most unpleasant towards [seclusion_rival.GetHerHim] even though that is unwarranted.
I hate [seclusion_rival.GetHerHim]!

Despite the festivities I have arranged in seclusion it seems [rival_courtier_1.GetBestName] and [rival_courtier_2.GetBestName] have not been getting along. In fact, the two of them seem to be considering each other fierce rivals.
Unfortunate, that...
I see...
It seems I might have an ally...
Good! Good!
It seems I might have an ally...
Good! Good!
I hope they destroy each other!

[seclusion_lover.GetBestName] is a most intriguing [seclusion_lover.GetManWoman], and I find myself drawn to [seclusion_lover.GetHerHim]. Perhaps [seclusion_lover.GetSheHe] and I am meant to be lovers...
I will proposition [seclusion_lover.GetHerHim]!
It is not meant to be...

It seems [From.GetBestName] has become quite enamored with me of late, seeing as [From.GetSheHe] just suggested that the two of us should try to slip away from the festivities to get to know one another much more intimately.
I never thought you'd ask!
I think not!

It seems [From.GetBestName] does not have the same feelings for me as I have for [From.GetHerHim], seeing as [From.GetSheHe] turned down my suggestion that the two of us should retire somewhere more privately to get to know one another much more intimately.
I see...

[From.GetBestName] was receptive to my suggestion, and with the rest of the court distracted by the ongoing festivities we were able to slip away without anyone noticing. After a very enjoyable time together, I need to decide whether I see this as a lasting thing or not.
This is the start of a lasting relationship!
It was fun, but let's not make a habit of it...

I have been having a good time at the festivities arranged by [From.GetBestName], especially in the company of [lover_courtier_2.GetBestName]. [lover_courtier_2.GetSheHeCap] is a most intriguing [lover_courtier_2.GetManWoman], and I find myself drawn to [lover_courtier_2.GetHerHim].
I should proposition [lover_courtier_2.GetHerHim]!
It's probably nothing...

I have been having a good time at the festivities arranged by [FromFrom.GetBestName], especially in the company of [lover_courtier_1.GetBestName]. [lover_courtier_1.GetSheHeCap] seems to have enjoyed my company quite a lot as well, seeing as [lover_courtier_1.GetSheHe] just propositioned me.
Let's slip away right now!
I don't think so!

It seems [From.GetBestName] does not feel the same way about me that I feel about [From.GetHerHim], seeing as [From.GetSheHe] did not appreciate my suggestion that the two of us should get to know each other much more intimately.
I see...

I have a very enjoyable time with [From.GetBestName], and [From.GetSheHe] seems to have felt the same way. As we are getting dressed again, I know that we need to decide whether this should become something lasting or not.
We should do this again!
This shouldn't become a long-term thing...

[annoyed_courtier.GetBestName] has let me know that [annoyed_courtier.GetSheHe] most definitely do not agree with my decision to attempt to make our time in seclusion more enjoyable. Apparently [annoyed_courtier.GetSheHe] thinks it a frivolous waste of our limited supplies of food.
You can't please everyone...

[happy_courtier.GetBestName] just told me [happy_courtier.GetSheHe] is very pleased with my decision to try to liven up the atmosphere while we are in seclusion. Plentiful food, plentiful drink, and general festivities seem to be just what [happy_courtier.GetSheHe] would have decided on if [happy_courtier.GetSheHe] was in charge.
I am glad to hear that!

I seem to have gained some weight lately, most likely due to the ongoing festivities. Some might think this unseemly, seeing as we are stuck in seclusion with fairly limited supplies, but I am not really sure I agree.
I think losing weight would be worse...

It is not just food that I have ensured a plentiful supply of at the ongoing festivities, but also a variety of strong drinks. I have found myself drinking more than I usually in the past, and I cannot say that that feels wrong.
Another round!
Though some might think it wrong when supplies are limited and while the peasants outside the walls might be starving, I have found that I enjoy the plentiful food during the festivities quite a bit.
Time for the third dessert!
Good food, pleasant company, plentiful drinks, and not a care in the world. Can a [Root.GetManWoman] really ask for more in life?
This truly is the life!
I am having fun, but not that much fun...

Some of the more pious [Root.Religion.GetName] faithful stuck with me in seclusion have started to express their concern that the festivities I have arranged and my participation in them are decadent and unseemly. They seem to think that this might bring shame on me and my dynasty.
If this is decadence, then so be it!
Having been spending more time talking to people during the festivities than I often have in the past, and I seem to have become better at saying the right thing at the right time as a result.
I think that will be most useful!

I have spent quite a bit of time socializing with the people at my court during the recent festivities, and it has been rather enjoyable. Perhaps it is something I should be focusing on more in the future, too.
This truly is the life!
I think I'd rather focus on other things...
It has become clear to me that maintaining a proper appearance is more necessary than I once considered, what with all the ongoing festivities having nearly everyone making an effort.
I must look my best!

Today some of the peasants outside approached the walls and demanded to speak to me. Apparently they seem to think that there are some kind of festivities underway inside while they are suffering outside.
Festivities? Here? Certainly not!
Why wouldn't we be enjoying ourselves?

It seems that despite our attempts to keep the peasants outside the walls from figuring out that we are having an enjoyable time while in seclusion they have found out. My guards have informed me that there are signs of unrest.
This might not be good...

The unrest outside the walls has grown beyond the point where it can be ignored. The peasants are up in arms, and are attempting to gain entry by force. I doubt the experience would be pleasant, should they gain entry.
Drive them back!
Under my capable leadership, the guards successfully repel the assault by the disorganized rabble outside the walls. The peasants flee in disarray, leaving their dead and dying behind.
And stay out!
Despite my leadership the guards lose control of the walls, and the peasant mob forces its way inside, hungry for blood. I am in a fight for my life, as is the rest of my court.
To arms!

The peasant mob is unstoppable, and though I believe that some members of my court manage to slip away in the confusion I and many others are cornered. Their leader, one [peasant_commander.GetBestName], directs the mob to show no mercy, particularly not to me.
Don't you know who I am?
The peasant mob cannot be stopped, and they leave many dead in their wake. They corner me and my personal guards, and show us no mercy.
Don't you know who I am?

In the end, we manage to drive the peasant mob back outside the walls, but I and many others are left crippled for life by the wounds the rabble inflicted. Dead and dying peasants are left behind by those that flee.
That went rather poorly...
At least there's fresh meat...

Though I and several others are wounded in the fighting, the peasant mob proves too disorganized to prevail even though they managed to get over the walls. Soon, they are driven back, leaving the corpses of their fallen comrades behind.
Not as bad as it could have been...
Well, I suppose we can replenish the food stores now...

The peasants clearly let their early success get to their heads and are taken by surprise when I lead the counterattack. Soon, they have been pushed back outside the walls, leaving their dead and dying behind.
And stay out!
It's nice when the food delivers itself!

[annoyed_courtier.GetBestName] has informed me that my insistence that everyone should try to stay busy while we are in seclusion most definitely is not to [annoyed_courtier.GetHerHis] liking. Apparently, [annoyed_courtier.GetSheHe] seems to think we should be relaxing instead.
You can't please everyone...

I have just learned that [happy_courtier.GetBestName] has been expressing quite a bit of satisfaction with the fact that I keep finding things for everyone to do while in seclusion. Clearly, [happy_courtier.GetSheHe] would have been bored out of [happy_courtier.GetHerHis] mind if we had just been trying to relax.
I am glad to hear that!

Seeing as there is less to do in seclusion than there otherwise would be, I have taken the time to go over the ledgers for the past several decades to check for any discrepancies, which I have been meaning to do for quite some time.
It's as good a way as any to pass the time...

The numbers do not add up. That much is clear to me. It might just be someone writing the wrong number by accident in places, or minor rounding errors in others, but taken all together it does not look good.
Something is wrong here...
Someone has stolen from me!
The numbers in the ledgers are what they should be, barring a couple of minor rounding errors. I have checked my calculations several times, and they always come out the same.
Everything looks good to me!
The ledgers are accurate, it seems...

Having checked the ledgers carefully, I have realized that there might be parts of my demesne that do not pay quite as much in taxes as they could. I am clearly missing out on some money that some would say rightfully is mine.
Double the taxes! Triple the taxes!
I don't need that much money...
I did not think I would enjoy looking over the ledgers as much as I have. Perhaps I should make a habit of doing it more often in the future.
Numbers are fun!
I don't really think I will keep doing this...
Being stuck in seclusion with less to do than normal alongside a good number of guards that likewise have less to do seems like an excellet opportunity to get some dueling practice.
I will get my sword!
While some of the guards are not very good duelists there are a few that stand out as exceptional swords[Root.GetMenWomen], and sparring with them turns out to be quite useful.
I learned a few new tricks!
I get distracted for a moment while sparring with the guards and fail to block an incoming blow as well as I should have. The wound I take is not as bad as it could have been, but it certainly hurts.
Ow!
While it is somewhat enjoyable I do not learn anything useful from sparring with my guards. Perhaps I need to find better sparring partners, once I am out of seclusion.
That's that, I guess...
I have taken the time to read as much as possible lately, trying to learn anything that could be of use when it comes to keeping myself and my realm safe.
I have learned a few new things!

Lately, I have found myself drawn to [seclusion_lover.GetBestName]. [seclusion_lover.GetSheHeCap] is surely as bored in seclusion as I am, and seeing as I am all but irresistible [seclusion_lover.GetSheHe] might appreciate a good tumble with me quite a bit.
I will proposition [seclusion_lover.GetHerHim]!
Actually, it would be a bad idea...

It seems [From.GetBestName] has gotten it into [From.GetHerHis] mind that I would appreciate a good tumble with [From.GetHerHim], seeing as [From.GetSheHe] just told me as much. [From.GetSheHeCap] has suggested we retire somewhere private without delay.
An excellent idea!
I don't think so!
It seems [From.GetBestName] is not as interested in a good tumble with me as I had thought, seeing as [From.GetSheHe] just turned me down.
I see...
I gave [From.GetBestName] a good tumble once we had retired to a private location, and [From.GetSheHe] seems to have enjoyed it as much as I did. We could perhaps try to do it again in the future.
I look forward to the next time!
I think we should end it here...
I have had more time for poetry than usual lately, seeing as I am stuck in seclusion. My latest poem took more time than I would have liked, but the result was quite good.
Time well spent!
Having found myself with less to do than I anticipated, I have decided to take up poetry. My first attempts were not promising, but I have gotten a lot better with practice.
And it's quite fun!
There was a time when I would have found it unthinkable to work as hard as I have been recently, but I seem to have changed as a person as I am finding it quite pleasant.
Hard work is rewarding!
Some would think that being stuck in seclusion without relaxing would be frustrating, but I cannot say I would agree with that sentiment-
I don't mind this at all!
Working hard has made me reconsider my past priorities. They no longer strike me as being as being ambitious enough.
I can surely achieve greater things!

I am working as hard as I can, but each time I think I have taken care of everything there is to do in seclusion I keep finding more things that require my attention, and delegating a few of them has not helped.
This is just too much...

Today I was approached by [annoyed_courtier.GetBestName]. [annoyed_courtier.GetSheHeCap] launched into a long tirade about how we all will starve to death thanks to my insistence that we eat less and how displeased [annoyed_courtier.GetSheHe] is with me.
You can't please everyone...

[happy_courtier.GetBestName] came to see me today, apparently wishing to express [happy_courtier.GetHerHis] appreciation for my wise decision to ensure that everyone eats a bit less to conserve our food stores for as long as possible.
I knew people would see it my way!

I spent some time today going over the food stores and having them reorganized in such a fashion that we both have a better idea what we still have and that the things that are more likely to spoil are consumed first.
Time well spent!

While there has been some grumbling about my insistence that everyone should eat a bit less and I have had second thoughts a few times, I am finding myself more and more content with having simpler and smaller meals than I once had.
I ate too much before!
I seem to have lost some weight recently, most likely because I am eating less than I once did. I suppose that that is to be expected.
It's probably fine...

[annoyed_courtier.GetBestName] has expressed quite a lot of unhappiness with my decision that we all should help grow food in seclusion. If [annoyed_courtier.GetSheHe] put as much time into helping out as [annoyed_courtier.GetSheHe] put into complaining, things would be going much smoother.
You can't please everyone...

It seems [annoyed_courtier.GetBestName] thinks I am setting a bad precedent by insisting that we all put some work in to grow additional food while in seclusion. Apparently [annoyed_courtier.GetSheHe] thinks that it is work only fit for peasants and that they might get ideas from us lowering ourselves to their level.
You can't please everyone...

Helping out with the attempt to grow additional food has made both me and my clothes quite dirty, and it is taking a lot of time and effort. I cannot really find the time to clean up as much as I once would have.
It's worth it, I think...

Gardening has at times taken some effort in the past, but doing it on the scale that I currently am is harder work than I had thought it would have been. It looked so easy when I saw the peasants do it in the past.
Maybe the peasants do have a hard life...

While I have dedicated most of the gardens towards growing food while in seclusion I have also been able to grow some potentially useful herbs in a few places that were not really suited for food. Some of them are ready for harvest.
These will be useful!
The latest harvest from the gardens has been completed, and it was quite bountiful. The food stores should last us quite a while longer now, which will be good if we need to remain in seclusion.
Time well spent!
[annoyed_courtier.GetBestName] seems to be rather annoyed with me investigating various rumours and me trying to keep track of people. I am unsure why that is the case.
You can't please everyone...
What is [annoyed_courtier.GetSheHe] up to...?

Recently, I have noticed that [sneaky_courtier.GetBestName] frequently vanishes for long periods of time and have caught [sneaky_courtier.GetHerHim] sneaking about in various places. [sneaky_courtier.GetSheHeCap] might be up to something!
I will follow [sneaky_courtier.GetHerHim]!
It's probably nothing...
